env.name: HELM_VALUES
env.value:
annotations:
  argocdvault: dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}
fullnameOverride: {serviceName}
replicaCount: {replicaCount}
pgconnectionconfig:
  enabled: true
  maxconnections: {maxconnections}
DBName: {dbName}
s3:
  accesskey: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#accesskey>
  secretkey: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#secretkey>
  host: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#s3.host>
resources:
  enabled: true
  limits:
    enabled: true
    memory: {memoryRequest}
  request:
    enabled: true
    cpu: {cpuRequest}
    memory: {memoryRequest}
walArchiving:
  s3:
    bucketName: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#bucketName>
dbusers:
  backup:
    password: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#dbadm.password>
  dbadm:
    username: profit_support
    password: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#dbadm.password>
  patroni:
    password: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#patroni.password>
  pgmon:
    password: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#pgmon.password>
  debezium:
    password: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#debezium.password>
  dataCatalog:
    password: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#dataCatalog.password>
persistence:
  size: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#size>
backup:
  enabled: true
  s3:
    bucketName: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#bucketName>
  retention: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#retention>
  resources:
    enabled: true
    limits:
      enabled: true
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 512Mi
    request:
      enabled: true
      cpu: 250m
      memory: 256Mi
  tempPgdataVolume:
    size: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#size>
  file:
    name: {dbname}-db-backup
restore:
  s3:
    bucketName: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#bucketName>
initdbScripts:
  script: <path:dna_aws_kv/data/{environment}/dbService/{serviceName}#init-db>
pgmonitoring:
  resources:
    enabled: true
    limits:
      enabled: true
      memory: 100Mi
    request:
      enabled: true
      cpu: 10m
      memory: 100Mi
podDisruptionBudget:
  minAvailable: {pdbMinAvailable}
